specs.quote: Single Nozzle Printing: 305*320*325 mm³ Dual Nozzle Printing: 300*320*325 mm³ Total Volume for Two Nozzles: 330*320*325 mm³
specs.test_condition: Single-nozzle printing (W×D×H). Dual-nozzle printing: 300 × 320 × 325 mm; total volume for two nozzles: 330 × 320 × 325 mm.
specs.conflict_note: The store page's spec table (H2C Specs › row 3) splits single-nozzle printing into 'Single Nozzle Printing: 325*320*320 mm³ (Left)' and '305*320*325 mm³ (Right)'; the spec sheet lists one single-nozzle volume, 305*320*325 mm³ (the page's right-nozzle value), and no left-nozzle line. The page parse took the left value, 325 × 320 × 320 mm. The page's features bullet says '330*320*325 mm³ Build Volume' (the total for two nozzles, which both sources give). Dual and total volumes agree. To adjudicate.

specs.test_condition: Built into the H2C Laser Edition (the Laser Full Combo's printer)

scope_evidence.quote: Built-in; 3264*2448 (Equipped with Laser Edition) … "59 sensors" is refer to fully equipped H2C Laser Edition with Bird's Eye camera

specs.conflict_note: The spec sheet states the camera without a version; the store page's row says 'Built-in; 3264*2448 (Equipped with Laser Edition)' and its box lists put 'H2C Laser Edition' only in the Laser Full Combo, so this row is scoped to that version. The page's own product-scope row (with its qualifier) is a different scope and stays; the resolution agrees.

REAL DISAGREEMENT: the store page's spec table (H2C Specs › row 40) says 'Built-in; 1600*1200'; the spec sheet says 'Built-in; 1920*1080' (the raw PDF text order confirms it: Live View, Nozzle, BirdsEye, Toolhead = 1920*1080, 1920*1080, 3264*2448, 1920*1080). The page carries newer edits than the sheet (the left-nozzle build volume line, the Vortek bundle), so the sheet may be the stale one. To adjudicate before commit.
